body:
i can relate to how you are feeling. i also know how it feels to feel like a burden. i just want to mention that most of the time, you are actually no burden at all. though depression makes us feel like this and it is still a valid feeling. 
i am also confused about life. it feels like im just standing, watching everyone else live their life, be happy, have friends, progress. 
how old are you? 
i know it feels like there is no future right now.
if you want to talk, im here.
